meta.note: Hand-finished goods for the journey. Every purchase funds the charitable works of the Flourish ministry.

categories.name: Apparel
categories.blurb: The clothing line — wear the harvest.

products.name: "Rooted" Heavyweight Tee
products.blurb: The tree anchored in stone. Heavyweight 7.2oz organic cotton, root-system print in deep relief.
products.description: A tee built to survive the journey. 7.2oz heavyweight organic cotton with a chiseled root-system chest print and a wheat-sheaf back crest. Garment-dyed in moss and basalt. Pre-shrunk, reinforced collar, made to be worn into the ground — and out of it.

products.name: Psalm 1 Sapling Hoodie
products.blurb: Planted by streams of water. Midweight fleece with embossed sapling + Psalm 1:3 in gold leaf.
products.description: Midweight 12oz brushed fleece hoodie. Embossed sapling crest on the chest, gold-leaf typeset of Psalm 1:3 down the left sleeve. Heavy drawcord, kangaroo pocket lined in linen. The leaf does not wither.

products.name: Armor of God Long-Sleeve
products.blurb: The full armor, etched in bronze. Long-sleeve with plate-texture print and Ephesians 6 cuff.
products.description: Long-sleeve tee in 6oz ringspun cotton. The front carries an etched bronze armor motif over chiseled stone; the left cuff is set with 'Eph 6:11' in struck-metal type. Built for the cooler mornings of the journey.

products.name: Harvest Field Cap
products.blurb: Wheat-sheaf emblem, structured crown, brushed canvas. The worker's cap.
products.description: Structured six-panel cap in brushed canvas. Wheat-sheaf emblem embroidered in gold and bronze thread on the front panel; woven 'Harvest' label at the back strap. Brass adjustment buckle. One size, built to weather.

products.name: "Wisdom Builds" Tote
products.blurb: Heavy canvas tote. Proverbs 24:3 struck in gold across the stone-panel front.
products.description: 16oz natural canvas tote with a reinforced base and leather-reinforced handles. The front panel is a chiseled stone slab bearing 'By wisdom a house is built — Prov 24:3' in struck-gold type. Carries the books, carries the groceries, carries the work.

products.name: "Fruitful" Olive Raglan
products.blurb: Three-quarter raglan with an olive-branch shoulder print bearing fig and fruit.
products.description: Three-quarter-sleeve raglan in heathered cotton. The right shoulder carries an olive branch bearing fig, pomegranate, and grape — the fruit of the Spirit made visible. Contrasting stone sleeves. A reminder that the branch abides to bear fruit.

products.name: Hand-Bound Scripture Journal
products.blurb: Full-grain leather, 200 lined pages, embossed root-system spine. The daily record.
products.description: Full-grain vegetable-tanned leather journal, 200 pages of acid-free lined paper, hand-stitched binding. The spine is embossed with a deep root system; the cover bears a recessed Flourish mark in bronze. Lay-flat binding, ribbon marker in moss. Ages with you.

products.name: Brass Page-Marker Set
products.blurb: Three solid brass line markers with wheat, olive, and vine finials. Never lose the verse.
products.description: A set of three solid brass line markers, each with a different finial — a wheat sheaf, an olive branch, and a twisting vine. Brushed finish, weighted to hold the line without creasing the page. Comes in a stamped kraft sleeve. Made to mark the place where wisdom met you.

products.name: Anointing Oil Kit
products.blurb: Cold-pressed olive oil in a hand-blown vial, with a pressed-stone dish. The old rite.
products.description: A 30ml vial of cold-pressed olive oil from first-press fruit, sealed in hand-blown glass with a bronze stopper. Paired with a pressed-basalt anointing dish, scored to pool the oil. A linen sleeve explains the rite. For the setting-apart of a person, a place, or a season.

products.name: Olive-Wood Pendant Cross
products.blurb: Carved from olive wood, hung on a bronze chain. The grain is the sermon.
products.description: A pendant cross hand-carved from a single piece of olive wood — every grain line intact, no two alike. Hung on a 22-inch brushed-bronze chain with a forged clasp. The wood is finished in beeswax and oil. Comes in a stamped kraft box with a linen sleeve.

products.name: Wheat-Motif Linen Bookmark
products.blurb: Woven linen with a wheat-sheaf border and a struck-verse center. Keeps the place.
products.description: A woven linen bookmark, 2 × 8 inches, with a wheat-sheaf border and a struck-gold verse at center: 'Your word is a lamp to my feet.' Hand-finished edges, no fray. Slender enough for the thinnest Bible paper.

products.name: Pocket Concordance Cover
products.blurb: Formed leather cover for a pocket concordance, embossed with a vine lattice.
products.description: A formed-leather cover sized for a standard pocket concordance, embossed with a twisting vine lattice and a recessed bronze Flourish mark. Magnetic flap closure, internal card slot. Vegetable-tanned, ages to a deep patina.

products.name: 365-Day Study Guide (Physical)
products.blurb: The full Year One companion in print. Hardcover, sewn binding, 384 pages.
products.description: The complete 365-day Year One curriculum in a single hardcover volume. Sewn binding, 384 pages on uncoated stock, with a chiseled-stone cover and a gold-leaf spine. The same daily seeds, scripture, and reflection prompts as the app — in a form you can underline, dog-ear, and hand down.

products.name: Foundations Devotional Card Set
products.blurb: 52 heavy-stock cards, one for each week of Year One. The foundation in your pocket.
products.description: A set of 52 heavy-stock devotional cards — one for each week of the foundation year. Each card carries a scripture, a one-line principle, and a single action. Pressed-basalt holder, bronze thumb-notch. Pull one each week. Carry it. Live it.

campaigns.title: Where Most Needed
campaigns.description: Gifts to the general fund let the ministry direct resources to the deepest need — a family in crisis, a printing run, a prison shipment, a roof. No restriction, full trust.

campaigns.title: Benevolence Fund
campaigns.description: Direct emergency help for families in the Flourish community facing eviction, medical bills, or sudden loss. Every gift passes through the hands of a pastor, not a processor.

campaigns.title: Prison Ministry — Bibles Behind Walls
campaigns.description: Sends the 365-Day Study Guide and a scripture journal into prisons across the country. One gift covers one inmate's full year of material and postage.

campaigns.title: The Printing Press
campaigns.description: Capital fund to own our own short-run press. Ends the per-unit margin paid to outside printers and lets us give books away at cost — or below it.
